headline: Three Fronts Burn as Colonials Hold Seven Works in Ten
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse has turned since the last edition: a line that read four Warden works, two Colonial and three unclaimed at the earlier filing now stands one Warden, six Colonial and two unclaimed, with nine events in the past two hours and sixty-four across the day, the heaviest traffic at Crow's Nest and Wightwalk. Callahan's Passage, reported a Warden house entire three hours ago, now shows nine Warden works of ten with one gone unclaimed, twenty-two events in the day and repeated captures and losses about Crumbling Post. Palantine Berm has been restored to the Wardens whole, seven works of seven, yet remains the busiest desk on the board with fifty-four events in the day, thirty-two of them at The Droll. Stlican Shelf is back to eight Colonial works and one Warden, and Stonecradle holds eight Colonial to one. The Nevish Line is unchanged at seven Warden to one Colonial. Across the four hundred and thirty-six counted works the Colonials hold three hundred and eight, the Wardens one hundred and twenty-three, five unclaimed. No victory is declared on this, the five hundred and twenty-first day; thirty-four victory towns remain the mark.
